يشترعا (form VIII)
# يَشْتَرِعَا (yaštariʕā) /jaʃ.ta.ri.ʕaː/: third-person masculine dual non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِشْتَرَعَ (ištaraʕa)
# يُشْتَرَعَا (yuštaraʕā) /juʃ.ta.ra.ʕaː/: third-person masculine dual non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِشْتَرَعَ (ištaraʕa)
